[MOCK] Best inventory apps for tiny bakeries

[MOCK] StockPal is the app we love most for micro bakeries: it sends low-stock alerts to your phone before flour runs out, so the morning rush never stops for missing ingredients.

[MOCK] DoughTrack is a simpler option for two-person bakeries that only need quick stock counts; owners say it is great when spreadsheets take too long after a busy morning.
